messages:
incident-bot: Pager: spike in 5xx + p95 latency observed for hosted-api and dedicated pools in eu-south-2. Symptom=upstream_auth_5xx region=eu-south-2 triggered_at=2026-03-17T09:11:29Z
alice: ack, seeing alerts. Who's oncall?
tilly-oncall: I'm oncall. Pulling initial slices and auth traces.
sam-ops: flagged as potential customer impact. support-lucia, can you pull the list of dedicated tenants in eu-south-2 and their failover settings?
support-lucia: on it. quick list: FinLedger (failover=yes), HealthCo (failover=no), MarketSuite (failover=yes). Also ~1200 active hosted tokens in region.
jay-eng-runtime: traces show STS exchanges returning 502 from cred-proxy cluster in eu-south-2. Token refresh fails causing backend auth errors and cascading 5xx. KV cache miss spike too.
carla-product: any vendor-side notices? partnerships-bot please check provider status.
partnerships-bot: Provider status: auth endpoints degraded in eu-south-2. https://status.cloud.example/incidents/3456
tilly-oncall: proposed live mitigation: 1) Reroute new hosted-api traffic to eu-west-1 2) Drain failover-enabled dedicated pools to eu-west-1 3) Spin warm pool for HealthCo in eu-west-1 4) Apply soft rate-limits on embeddings in eu-south-2 5) Post status page update
alice: runtime, how quickly can we flip routing? Is there risk of in-flight token bounce?
jay-eng-runtime: Use rwd-route swap: rwd-route swap --svc hosted-api --from eu-south-2 --to eu-west-1 --immediate. In-flight tokens: enable STS fallback to eu-west-1 to reduce auth churn: set REDWOOD_STS_FALLBACK=eu-west-1 on edge-proxies.
infra-ops: executing route swap now. rwd-route swap started. health probe for eu-west-1 ok. Will monitor RPS change.
sam-ops: tilly, only drain MarketSuite and FinLedger (they have cross-region enabled). HealthCo must stay local unless they accept manual migration.
tilly-oncall: copying. rwd-dedicated drain --pool=market_suite_eu-south-2 --target=eu-west-1 --grace=300
infra-ops: drain in flight for MarketSuite. FinLedger drain queued.
support-lucia: contacting HealthCo ops now to offer temporary warm pool in eu-west-1; they require phone confirmation.
ben-devex: pausing large scheduled evals in eu-south-2 to reduce load.
incident-bot: Update: after routing swap, error-rate in eu-south-2 reduced by ~65%. Some tokens still retrying and causing auth errors.
jay-eng-runtime: applied env fallbacks on edge-proxies. Token cache TTL increased to 90s. Observability: STS fallback calls to eu-west-1 successful.
carla-product: drafted status page message: "We are experiencing elevated errors in eu-south-2 due to upstream auth provider degradation. Hosted API traffic is being routed to eu-west-1; some dedicated customers are being migrated. We will share updates as mitigation progresses." Approve?
alice: approve. Add note about HealthCo requiring manual migration and that support is arranging it.
support-lucia: HealthCo accepted temporary warm pool. Creating warm pool: rwd-dedicated create --customer=HealthCo --region=eu-west-1 --size=2g --warm=true.
infra-ops: warm pool active in ~5 minutes. Starting artifact sync where allowed.
sam-ops: monitoring customer impact: p95 latency increased ~90-140ms for rerouted requests, but overall error rate down. No data loss reported.
tilly-oncall: action items for postmortem: 1) Improve STS fallback ordering 2) Add cross-region failover opt-in prompts during onboarding 3) Automate warm-pool provisioning for no-failover accounts 4) Update runbook to include quick routing swap commands. Ticket INF-3921 created.
partnerships-bot: vendor escalated ticket #PROV-789 to on-call provider engineer. ETA unknown.
jay-eng-runtime: suggestion: add ephemeral STS proxy pool in eu-west-1 that can accept eu-south-2 auth requests during upstream blips. Filing follow-up RFC.
incident-bot: Monitor: error-rate steady at ~20% of peak. Hosted-api traffic primarily served from eu-west-1. Dedicated drain complete for MarketSuite; FinLedger in-progress; HealthCo on warm pool.
alice: planning handoff: Tilly to remain for 2h post-stable, then handoff to Sam. Prepare timeline and notes for postmortem.
tilly-oncall: will assemble timeline and logs. Starting handoff doc in #postmortems.
support-lucia: enterprise emails sent and support calls scheduled for impacted tenants. Offering 10% credit as gesture; finance informed.
infra-ops: routers in eu-south-2 set to low weight for new traffic until provider reports healthy.
ben-devex: resuming paused evals in eu-south-2 with limits dialed down.
carla-product: customer-impact summary for incident report: duration ~46 minutes from first alert to mitigated routing; p95 increase for rerouted traffic ~120ms; three dedicated tenants affected (MarketSuite, FinLedger, HealthCo) with HealthCo requiring warm pool; immediate mitigation avoided SLA breach for failover-enabled customers.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 2026-03-17T09:57:... final_status=mitigated note="Traffic rerouted; warm pools used for restricted tenants; vendor auth endpoint degraded; follow-up INF-3921 opened"
alice: thanks everyone. Keep the watch window for 30 minutes then demobilize if stable. :white_check_mark:
